text: Hallelujah! I Praise the name of the Lord!Praise, you servants of the Lord, [AA]
Who stand in the house of the Lord,in the courts of the house of our God! [AB]
Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good!Sing to his name, for it brings joy!
t[1]For the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself,Israel as his treasured possession. [AC]
II For I know that the Lord is great,that our Lord is greater than all gods. [AD]
Whatever the Lord desireshe does in heaven and on earth,in the seas and all the depths. [AE]
It is he who raises storm clouds from the end of the earth,makes lightning for the rain,and brings forth wind from his storehouse. [AF]
III He struck down Egypt's firstborn, [AG]of human being and beast alike,
And sent signs and wonders against you, Egypt,against Pharaoh and all his servants.
It is he who struck down many nations, [AH]and slew mighty kings—
Sihon, king of the Amorites,and Og, king of Bashan,all the kings of Canaan—
And made their land a heritage,a heritage for Israel his people.
O Lord, your name is forever,your renown, from generation to generation! [AI]
For the Lord defends his people,shows mercy to his servants. [AJ]
IV The idols of the nations are silver and gold, [AK]the work of human hands.
They have mouths but do not speak;they have eyes but do not see;
They have ears but do not hear;nor is there breath in their mouths.
Their makers will become like them,and anyone who trusts in them.
V House of Israel, bless the Lord! [AL]House of Aaron, bless the Lord!
House of Levi, bless the Lord!You who fear the Lord, bless the Lord!
Blessed be the Lord from Zion,who dwells in Jerusalem!Hallelujah!
